description:
In this clip from Hammerhead Sharks Up Close, Bertie Gregory, National Geographic explorer and wildlife photographer, encounters a surprising ocean predator while searching for sharks: a whale. In this stunning, 4K footage, watch a bryde's whale devour its next meal.

author: National Geographic
description:
National Geographic explorer and wildlife filmmaker, Bertie Gregory, travels to South America for his most audacious mission yet: filming great white sharks without a protective cage as they hunt in the shallows. While filming the massive apex predators, Bertie learns about their challenges in the face of climate change, and the changes to oceans around the globe.
